name: Will a water softener affect my water pressure?

mainEntity.name: Will a water softener affect my water pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly installed and maintained water softener should not significantly affect your home's water pressure. Issues with water pressure are usually rare but can sometimes occur if the unit is improperly sized, if there's a blockage, or if installation was not done correctly. Our technicians ensure the system integrates smoothly with your existing plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: A properly installed water softener should not significantly affect water pressure; issues are rare but can occur with improper sizing or installation.
